items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanse that won't strip skin that already looks dry and dull.
A beginner-friendly retinol strength to help soften the look of fine lines and improve the look of firmness over time.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to comfort skin that scans as low in moisture and to cushion the retinol.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is needed with retinol and helps keep lines from looking deeper.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanse, moisturizer, then sunscreen. Evenings: cleanse, then retinol just 2 nights a week with moisturizer on top, building up slowly as skin feels comfortable, and pause it if skin feels stinging or tight.
